basis: Defining cardiac/neurodevelopmental defects and cleft lip/palate (2/2); asplenia in 1/2; skeletal contractures/kyphosis and nail defects omitted by cap.
Carcinoma originating in breast tissue, which has no axis; metastatic sites are not inherent organ involvement.
Defined as an eye developmental disorder caused by defective PAX6 regulation.
Contractural skeletal disorder; aortic root aneurysm and mitral prolapse each reported in 11/22, despite broader occasional cardiac annotations; ear shape alone does not establish dysfunction.
Defined by motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting reflects denervation rather than a separate direct myopathy.
Combined pituitary hormone deficiency with defining cerebellar malformation; small sella and delayed bone age do not establish skeletal damage.
COFS denotes cerebral, ocular and skeletal malformations; microcephaly and arthrogryposis occur in 5/5; microphthalmia is occasional in this subtype.
Clostridioides difficile infection directly causes colonic inflammation; systemic symptoms do not establish other organ damage.
SDHB-related adrenal and autonomic paraganglionic tumor syndrome; renal carcinoma and GIST are separate predisposed tumors, not involved organs.
Isolated dental enamel formation disorder; enamel hypoplasia in 2/2. LAMB3 alone does not establish skin involvement.
Acute myringitis affects the tympanic membrane and is usually bacterial or viral; no evidence of damage beyond the ear.
Inherited melanin synthesis disorder affecting skin/hair pigmentation and ocular development, with substantial visual impairment.
Axonal peripheral neuropathy; hepatic steatosis in 4/11 (~36%) with reported transaminase elevation; muscle wasting reflects denervation.
Inherited carcinoma of adrenal cortex; renal ancestry contradicts the definition. Choroid plexus carcinoma is a separate neoplasm.
Defining cerebellar, hepatic and ocular coloboma syndrome; hepatic fibrosis 10/12 and coloboma 5/12; nephronophthisis damages kidneys in 5/12 (~42%).
SP7-related bone fragility, osteoporosis and skeletal deformity; delayed tooth eruption alone does not establish lasting dental damage.
Peroxisome biogenesis disorder; pachygyria 11/14, hepatic injury/hepatomegaly 2/4 and tricuspid regurgitation 2/4; individual ocular, hearing and renal findings each 1/4.
Granulomatous inflammation damages the pituitary; primary idiopathic hypophysitis is generally considered immune mediated. Pituitary location alone does not add neurologic disease.
Tumor originates in endocrine pancreatic delta cells; pancreatic endocrine tissue belongs to the metabolic_endocrine axis.
Neoplasm of the biliary tract; intrahepatic and extrahepatic bile ducts and gallbladder belong to the hepatic axis.
Bile-acid synthesis defect causes cholestatic liver injury; fat malabsorption is frequent (30-79%); coagulopathy is secondary to hepatic/vitamin K dysfunction.
MNGIE-type mitochondrial disorder with neuropathy and intestinal pseudo-obstruction; biopsy-proven myopathy in 2/2; ophthalmoplegia (2/2) omitted as an additional ocular axis by cap.
Localized neuroendocrine tumor of carotid-body paraganglionic tissue, classified as peripheral nervous system and endocrine neoplasm; carotid proximity does not imply vascular disease.
Congenital finger overgrowth with frequent hyperostosis and hand-bone exostoses; median/ulnar entrapment neuropathies are occasional (5-29%).
ABCC8-related transient neonatal diabetes is an endocrine pancreatic insulin-secretion disorder; no common direct extra-endocrine damage established.
